entities.summary: Lindy Waters III is a Kiowa and Cherokee-American professional basketball player for the San Antonio Spurs of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Oklahoma State Cowboys. He was named a finalist for the NBA 2023–24 Social Justice Champion Award for the work his foundation does to support Native American youth through sports, health and wellness.
